# W=1 and sparse warnings that CI accepts for now.
#
# Everything in this list needs a logic change to fix, so it is left for
# Phase 2 (see "Known issues for Phase 2" in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Any
# warning not matched here fails the "Extra warnings and sparse" CI step.
#
# One POSIX extended regex per line, matched against the warning line with
# the checkout directory stripped. Line/column numbers are wildcarded so
# unrelated edits do not invalidate an entry.
